description: This file is a shell script designed to test reflog display routines in Git. It contains various test cases that verify the output of Git commands related to reflog views, formats, dates, and behavior with empty or specific references.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a label and command sequence.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two outputs/files and verifies they are identical.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the given output is empty.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
